extracted.intended_audience: media representatives, journalists, and CDCR institutional staff (wardens, communications staff, PIOs)
extracted.subtask_description: Describes the designation, duties, and contact-list maintenance for Public Information Officers (PIOs) at CDCR institutions and parole regions. Explains who serves as PIO and the PIO's responsibilities for media relations and community information programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designation of Public Information Officer (PIO)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each institution and parole region designates an appropriate staff member as a Public Information Officer (PIO).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designation is done at the institution and parole-region level; the designated person should be an appropriate staff member responsible for public information duties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate public information and community relations
rubrics_metrics.description: The PIO coordinates public information and community relations programs within state prisons and parole regions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordination includes overseeing the institution's public-facing communications and engagement with community stakeholders on behalf of the facility or parole region.

rubrics_metrics.name: Serve as Warden/Institution Head’s Administrative Assistant
rubrics_metrics.description: The PIO is also the Warden/institution head’s Administrative Assistant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The role combines administrative support to the Warden/institution head with communications responsibilities; PIOs may perform tasks typical of an administrative assistant in addition to media duties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designee to respond to media requests
rubrics_metrics.description: The PIO is the institution’s designee to respond to media requests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All media inquiries for the institution or parole region are to be handled by the designated PIO, who serves as the official point of contact for journalists and media outlets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain and publish PIO contact listings
rubrics_metrics.description: PIO Listing: Adult Institutions Public Information Officers; Adult Parole Operations Contacts; DJJ Public Information Officer Contacts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The department provides and maintains listings of PIO contacts for adult institutions, parole operations, and DJJ to ensure media and public can find the appropriate designee for inquiries.
